_about: Edward Caird (1835-1908), raw IA OCR: The Social Philosophy and Religion of Comte (Glasgow: MacLehose, 1885), The Evolution of Religion (Gifford Lectures, St Andrews; New York: Macmillan, 1893, 2 vols.), The Evolution of Theology in the Greek Philosophers (Gifford Lectures, Glasgow; MacLehose, 1904, 2 vols.) and The Critical Philosophy of Immanuel Kant (second edition, MacLehose, 1909, 2 vols.). US public domain. His brother John Caird has his own shelf (john-caird). No uids minted.
